create_mcp_jwt_signer: create an MCPJWTSigner instance to sign outbound MCP requests with RS256 JWTs
get_mcp_jwt_signer: get the active MCPJWTSigner singleton instance for JWKS discovery
get_jwks: get the JWKS containing the RSA public key for MCP server token verification
async_pre_call_hook: verify incoming bearer tokens and sign outbound JWTs as Authorization headers for MCP tool calls
build_scope: build JWT scope strings for tool-level access control in MCP requests
